paragraphs.text: Atris is a human advisor from Theros .
Atris is an oracle whose origins are shrouded in mystery. He is presumably associated with Phenax , and he is known to give out false prophecies at a moment's whim.
Oracles such as Atris and Kydele are occasionally known to bestow supernatural gifts to various heroes of Theros.
Atris fought in defense of Theros during the New Phyrexian Invasion .
